notes.title: 0.7.3 Item Database, Item Notes & update on the 'Ask Your Supervisor' app
notes.notes:
[h3]Item Database[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/e35c060feabd498db21913a2d72f3190769932cb.png[/img]
Added a new app on the tablet 'Item Database'. Here, you can view every item in the game. Initially, items will appear undiscovered, shown only as silhouettes with '???' as it's name. Once you discover an item, its name and image will be revealed. To unlock its full details, such as whether its prohibited type and which confiscation bin it belongs to, you will need to scan it using the substance scanner.
[h3]Item Notes[/h3]
Added item notes: You can now interact with bag items and click the 'Notes' button to leave a personal note for that item. These notes will also show and be editable in the item database.
[h3]Ask Your Supervisor has moved[/h3]
The 'Ask Your Supervisor' app has moved! - Its primary design was to have it as a helper, not a prominent feature, so you'll now find a "Still need help?" button at the bottom of the procedures manual to access this feature from now on.
It turns out people aren't a big fan of AI as a whole, not just the art creation varieties - as a reminder, everything you need to know about the game can be found in the procedures manual, and by using the new item database. The feature will remain in it's new subtle location for anyone who wishes to use it as an accessibility tool.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112577/5af9323ad7db2de5d23e9fdb5e170c4e6e6f5d24.png[/img]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a critical confiscation bug which ignored non-prohibited items and would incorrectly tell you they were mishandled instead of incorrectly confiscated.
- Fixed an issue that prevented you from moving wall items that were above the conveyor ends.
- Fixed a bug that still showed 'Fruits & Vegetables' on the physical notice of confiscation note.

Thanks for your patience

notes.title: 0.5.4.5 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]A larger update is in progress, but for the time being I just wanted to fix a few bugs - Thanks for your patience![/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a UI scaling issue on certain resolutions.
[*] Fixed a missing translation bug on the bag pushers.
[*] Fixed a rounding issue on the end-of-day score.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused bags to incorrectly be marked as being on the flagged luggage rack if the rack was placed too close to the conveyor.
[*] Fixed a bug that would break the substance scanner if an object was left inside at the end of the day.
[*] Added a reflection probe to the scene, this should have minimal performance impact but make shinier materials look better.
[/list]

notes.title: Small holiday update
notes.notes:
V0.4.4.5

I will be back to working hard on improvements and updates soon! Hope you all had an amazing Christmas.

notes.title: Initial colourblind support - Bug Fixes - Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]V0.4.4[/b]
- Fixed an issue with firearm permits.  
- Fixed a bug that prevented penalization from working correctly.  
- Added initial colourblind support to the x-ray machine, toggleable using 'M'. [b]This is in early stages[/b], and feedback is welcome.  
- Added accessibility information in the settings, which currently allows disabling "challenging events."  
- Moved build mode from the pause menu to toggle with 'B'.  
- Began redesigning the overhead display: it will now show information on events and daily restrictions. Passenger threat info has been temporarily disabled until improvements are made.  
- X-ray machine black-and-white upgrade is now free for everyone, and the upgrade has been replaced with a conveyor remote control.  
- Reduced the spawn rate of drugs slightly.  
- Adjusted rates at which prohibited items spawn, so you should now see more items to confiscate and fewer to flag.  
- Added a new event: Malfunctioning conveyor belt.  
- Added 3 new models.  
- Fixed mistakes in the German translation.

notes.title: Improved preset packing, improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]V0.4.2[/b]
- Updated bag presets to appear more naturally packed, reducing the overly "robotic" look. Feedback is encouraged, and further adjustments are planned.  
- Fixed two issues that caused items to fall through bags when closing lids.  
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to repeatedly sell floor text after exiting and reloading.  
- Fixed a bug where the total items discovered could exceed the current maximum.  
- Adjusted the procedures manual: the "Ammo" section no longer incorrectly mentions grenades, which are classified as explosives.  
- Reduced the spawn rate of adult toys slightly.  
- Reduced the frequency of currency spawns but increased the overall amount per stack.  
- Adjusted the scale of currency notes to better match their intended size.  
- Modified the scale of soda cans slightly.  
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Dutch (nl) now supported - Small bug fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
- Dutch (nl) language is now supported. Please note that the community translation is still in progress and may contain errors. If you spot any, feel free to reach out and let us know.  
- Fixed missing translations in the incorrectly flagged summary info.  
- Added information about "blunt tools" being prohibited under the "non-lethal weapons" category in the procedures manual.  
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Small bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
